title: Constellation Network
description: Dots slowly move and connect with lines — like a living star map.
cssCode: html,body,#container{margin:0;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden;}canvas{display:block;}
jsCode: const el=document.getElementById('container');const c=document.createElement('canvas');const ctx=c.getContext('2d');c.width=el.offsetWidth||400;c.height=el.offsetHeight||500;el.appendChild(c);const W=c.width,H=c.height;const dots=Array.from({length:80},()=>({x:Math.random()*W,y:Math.random()*H,vx:(Math.random()-0.5)*0.5,vy:(Math.random()-0.5)*0.5,r:Math.random()*2+1}));function draw(){ctx.fillStyle='rgba(5,5,16,0.2)';ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);dots.forEach(d=>{d.x+=d.vx;d.y+=d.vy;if(d.x<0||d.x>W)d.vx*=-1;if(d.y<0||d.y>H)d.vy*=-1;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(d.x,d.y,d.r,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fillStyle='#a78bfa';ctx.shadowColor='#7c3aed';ctx.shadowBlur=8;ctx.fill();});for(let i=0;i<dots.length;i++){for(let j=i+1;j<dots.length;j++){const dx=dots[i].x-dots[j].x,dy=dots[i].y-dots[j].y,dist=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy);if(dist<100){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(dots[i].x,dots[i].y);ctx.lineTo(dots[j].x,dots[j].y);ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(167,139,250,${1-dist/100})`;ctx.lineWidth=0.6;ctx.stroke();}}}requestAnimationFrame(draw);}draw();

title: Particle Vortex
description: Hundreds of particles spiral into a glowing center — mesmerizing black hole effect.
cssCode: canvas{display:block;}
jsCode: const el=document.getElementById('container');const c=document.createElement('canvas');const ctx=c.getContext('2d');c.width=el.offsetWidth||400;c.height=el.offsetHeight||500;el.appendChild(c);const W=c.width,H=c.height,CX=W/2,CY=H/2;const particles=Array.from({length:300},()=>{const angle=Math.random()*Math.PI*2,radius=Math.random()*Math.min(W,H)*0.45+20;return{angle,radius,speed:(0.008+Math.random()*0.015)*(Math.random()<0.5?1:-1),size:Math.random()*2+0.5,hue:260+Math.random()*60,alpha:Math.random()*0.8+0.2};});function draw(){ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.06)';ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);const grd=ctx.createRadialGradient(CX,CY,0,CX,CY,40);grd.addColorStop(0,'rgba(168,85,247,0.8)');grd.addColorStop(0.4,'rgba(124,58,237,0.3)');grd.addColorStop(1,'transparent');ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(CX,CY,40,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fillStyle=grd;ctx.fill();particles.forEach(p=>{p.angle+=p.speed;p.radius-=0.08;if(p.radius<5){p.radius=Math.random()*Math.min(W,H)*0.45+20;p.angle=Math.random()*Math.PI*2;}const x=CX+Math.cos(p.angle)*p.radius,y=CY+Math.sin(p.angle)*p.radius*0.5;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,y,p.size,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fillStyle=`hsla(${p.hue},90%,70%,${p.alpha})`;ctx.shadowColor=`hsl(${p.hue},90%,60%)`;ctx.shadowBlur=6;ctx.fill();});requestAnimationFrame(draw);}draw();

title: Synthwave Retro Grid
description: 80s retro perspective grid with neon glow — moves toward you forever.
cssCode: canvas{display:block;}
jsCode: const el=document.getElementById('container');const c=document.createElement('canvas');const ctx=c.getContext('2d');c.width=el.offsetWidth||400;c.height=el.offsetHeight||500;el.appendChild(c);const W=c.width,H=c.height;let offset=0;function drawGrid(){ctx.fillStyle='#050008';ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);const grd=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,H*0.45,0,H*0.6);grd.addColorStop(0,'rgba(236,72,153,0.6)');grd.addColorStop(1,'transparent');ctx.fillStyle=grd;ctx.fillRect(0,H*0.45,W,H*0.15);const horizon=H*0.5,vp={x:W/2,y:horizon},cols=12,step=W/cols;ctx.lineWidth=1;for(let i=0;i<=cols;i++){const x=i*step,alpha=1-Math.abs(i-cols/2)/(cols/2)*0.6;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x,H);ctx.lineTo(vp.x,horizon);ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(167,139,250,${alpha*0.8})`;ctx.shadowColor='#a78bfa';ctx.shadowBlur=4;ctx.stroke();}const rows=10;for(let i=0;i<rows;i++){const t=(i/rows+offset)%1,ease=t*t,y=horizon+(H-horizon)*ease,alpha=ease*0.9+0.1;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(0,y);ctx.lineTo(W,y);ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(167,139,250,${alpha})`;ctx.shadowColor='#a78bfa';ctx.shadowBlur=3;ctx.stroke();}const sunGrd=ctx.createRadialGradient(W/2,horizon,0,W/2,horizon,60);sunGrd.addColorStop(0,'rgba(251,191,36,0.9)');sunGrd.addColorStop(0.4,'rgba(236,72,153,0.7)');sunGrd.addColorStop(1,'transparent');ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(W/2,horizon,60,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fillStyle=sunGrd;ctx.fill();offset=(offset+0.004)%1;requestAnimationFrame(drawGrid);}drawGrid();

jsCode: const el=document.getElementById('container');const c=document.createElement('canvas');const ctx=c.getContext('2d');c.width=el.offsetWidth||400;c.height=el.offsetHeight||500;el.appendChild(c);const W=c.width,H=c.height;let t=0;const blobs=[{x:W*0.3,y:H*0.3,r:W*0.5,hue:260,speed:0.4},{x:W*0.7,y:H*0.6,r:W*0.45,hue:190,speed:0.3},{x:W*0.5,y:H*0.8,r:W*0.4,hue:310,speed:0.5},{x:W*0.2,y:H*0.7,r:W*0.38,hue:150,speed:0.35}];function draw(){ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,16,0.08)';ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);blobs.forEach((b,i)=>{b.x=W*(0.2+0.6*Math.abs(Math.sin(t*b.speed*0.01+i*1.2)));b.y=H*(0.2+0.6*Math.abs(Math.cos(t*b.speed*0.008+i*0.9)));const grd=ctx.createRadialGradient(b.x,b.y,0,b.x,b.y,b.r);grd.addColorStop(0,`hsla(${b.hue+t*0.2},100%,60%,0.35)`);grd.addColorStop(0.5,`hsla(${b.hue+60+t*0.1},90%,50%,0.15)`);grd.addColorStop(1,'transparent');ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(b.x,b.y,b.r,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fillStyle=grd;ctx.fill();});t++;requestAnimationFrame(draw);}draw();

title: DNA Double Helix
description: Rotating 3D-like DNA strand — pure canvas magic.
cssCode: canvas{display:block;}
jsCode: const el=document.getElementById('container');const c=document.createElement('canvas');const ctx=c.getContext('2d');c.width=Math.min(el.offsetWidth||400,400);c.height=el.offsetHeight||500;el.appendChild(c);const W=c.width,H=c.height;let t=0;function draw(){ctx.fillStyle='rgba(5,5,15,0.15)';ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);const cx=W/2,nodes=28,spacing=H/nodes;for(let i=0;i<nodes;i++){const y=i*spacing-(t%spacing),phase=(i/nodes)*Math.PI*4+t*0.04,amp=W*0.28,x1=cx+Math.cos(phase)*amp,x2=cx+Math.cos(phase+Math.PI)*amp,z1=Math.sin(phase),z2=Math.sin(phase+Math.PI),r1=5+z1*3,r2=5+z2*3;if(i%2===0){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x1,y);ctx.lineTo(x2,y);ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(6,182,212,0.35)';ctx.lineWidth=1.5;ctx.stroke();}ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x1,y,Math.max(r1,1),0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(167,139,250,${0.4+z1*0.5})`;ctx.shadowColor='#a78bfa';ctx.shadowBlur=r1*3;ctx.fill();ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x2,y,Math.max(r2,1),0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(6,182,212,${0.4+z2*0.5})`;ctx.shadowColor='#06b6d4';ctx.shadowBlur=r2*3;ctx.fill();}t+=1.2;requestAnimationFrame(draw);}draw();

title: Electric Lightning
description: Realistic branching lightning bolt with glow effect.
cssCode: canvas{display:block;}
jsCode: const el=document.getElementById('container');const c=document.createElement('canvas');const ctx=c.getContext('2d');c.width=el.offsetWidth||400;c.height=el.offsetHeight||500;el.appendChild(c);const W=c.width,H=c.height;function lightning(x1,y1,x2,y2,d,depth){if(d<2||depth<=0){ctx.moveTo(x1,y1);ctx.lineTo(x2,y2);return;}const mx=(x1+x2)/2+(Math.random()-0.5)*d,my=(y1+y2)/2+(Math.random()-0.5)*d;lightning(x1,y1,mx,my,d/2,depth-1);lightning(mx,my,x2,y2,d/2,depth-1);if(Math.random()<0.3){const bx=mx+(Math.random()-0.5)*d*2,by=my+Math.random()*d*2;lightning(mx,my,bx,by,d/3,depth-2);}}function flash(){ctx.fillStyle='rgba(2,2,8,0.85)';ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);const sx=W*0.3+Math.random()*W*0.4,ex=W*0.2+Math.random()*W*0.6;ctx.beginPath();ctx.lineWidth=8;ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(167,139,250,0.15)';lightning(sx,0,ex,H,120,7);ctx.stroke();ctx.beginPath();ctx.lineWidth=3;ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(196,181,253,0.5)';ctx.shadowColor='#a78bfa';ctx.shadowBlur=15;lightning(sx,0,ex,H,120,7);ctx.stroke();ctx.beginPath();ctx.lineWidth=1;ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.95)';ctx.shadowColor='#ffffff';ctx.shadowBlur=8;lightning(sx,0,ex,H,120,7);ctx.stroke();ctx.shadowBlur=0;}function loop(){flash();setTimeout(loop,Math.random()<0.4?80+Math.random()*120:600+Math.random()*1200);}loop();
